description: This file defines types, interfaces, and a class related to code completion features for the Ace editor, specifically for the Thingsboard project. It includes models for completion items, their metadata, and a completer class implementing the Ace API.

classes.name: TbEditorCompleter
classes.description: Implements the Ace.Completer interface to provide code completion suggestions based on the defined models and data.

methods.name: updateCompletions
methods.description: Updates the internal completions data with new suggestions.

methods.name: getCompletions
methods.description: Provides completion suggestions for the current editor context.

methods.name: resolvePath
methods.description: Resolves the nested path in the completions object based on the prefix.

methods.name: prepareCompletions
methods.description: Prepares a list of Ace completions based on the prefix.

methods.name: toAceCompletionsList
methods.description: Converts nested completions into a flat list of Ace completion objects.

methods.name: toAceCompletion
methods.description: Creates an Ace completion object from a completion model.

methods.name: getDocTooltip
methods.description: Generates HTML tooltip documentation for a completion item.

methods.name: createDocHTML
methods.description: Creates detailed HTML documentation for a completion item, including parameters and return info.
